title: USO camp show with Celeste Holm; Nuremberg
summary: After discharge he leads the orchestra for a six-month show; an accident ends it.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Anyway, when we got, oh I don't suppose you want to hear more about this. I got my discharge in Paris and went with one of the USO camp shows for a six month period. And Celeste Holm was our star and I was the orchestra leader and Marian was the manager of the show. And we went to the Nuremberg Trials about the fifth month or so.

And on the way there Marian was in a jeep and I was in a weapons carrier. But Marian's jeep had an accident and she broke her wrist. Went to the hospital and that was the end of our show. It busted up. But we had already been to England and the South of France and everything else and visited, met her parents and
so forth before. And I was blowing my horn again anyway. So we eventually well we came back together on the boat and came to New York to stay with Gene Krupa.
